mechanism: A text memory = experience/lessons/v0/lessons.txt (1,662 chars, distilled from the SAME 20 tasks x 2 models — train-on-test, so a PLUMBING test only)
comparison: v0.3 3B no memory on the same 20 tasks: 8/20, 9.25 actions, failed-episode regions {1:11, 3:1}
finding: The text-memory carrier works end to end (lessons reach the prompt; +~400 tokens/turn). The v0 lessons did not help: 5/20 vs 8/20, one seed, n=20 - not significant either way, and they were distilled from these very tasks. Fixation is unchanged (15/15 failed episodes on one region) and with v0.4 labels the dominant waste is noop_patch (107/204): the model re-emits the shown code. So two separable deficits: LOCALIZATION (which region first - what a prior can buy) and REPAIR (writing the fix once localized - a capability floor of the model on B_state/C_types classes). first_correct_hypothesis_step already measures localization; the paper should report both, and P1 should be scored on localization cost as well as actions-to-green.
